concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-manage-user-capabilities]] — 2026-09-15 account-holder getGrantOffers/receiveGrants requirements and requested, allowed, enabled and verification-state management before separate offer/grant steps.
warnings: Requested, allowed, enabled, and verificationStatus are distinct; request submission is not approval or an offer.
Both capabilities allowed plus Terms of Service lets the platform proceed to a separate disbursement request, not proof of executed funding.
Dated supported regions and Capital enablement/roles must be checked for the account; capability state does not establish current offer/funding outcome.
